name: Jehoahaz
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: His servants carried him dead in a chariot from Megiddo to Jerusalem and buried him, and the people took Jehoahaz his son and anointed him king in his father's place.

note.label: 2 Kings 23: Josiah Reads the Law and Cleanses the Land

points: Jehoahaz was twenty three years old and reigned three months in Jerusalem, and did evil in the sight of the Lord according to all his fathers had done.

note.label: 2 Kings 23: Josiah Reads the Law and Cleanses the Land

points: Josiah had four sons: Johanan, Jehoiakim, Zedekiah and Shallum; Jehoiakim's son Jeconiah is the Jehoiachin of Kings and the Jechonias of Matthew.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: The people of the land take Jehoahaz the son of Josiah and make him king in Jerusalem; he is twenty three years old and reigns three months.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 36: The Captivity of Judah into Babylon

cases.name: Jehoahaz (Shallum) of Judah
cases.charge: Doing evil in the sight of the Lord according to all that his fathers had done
cases.preview: After Josiah fell at Megiddo the people of the land anointed his son Jehoahaz, called Shallum, and in three months he did evil according to all his fathers had done (2 Kings 23:30-32).
